Fantastic World , released by the Madrid manufacturer Peyper in 1985, is a single-player machine approved for sale in Spain under type-approval number A/13/00145.

- Manufacturer: Peyper
- Years made: 1985
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Original Theme, 1980s
